title: A Canon of the Rising Swell
summary: A canon on lifting water qi from the legs in a slow swell that carries a strike or a guard and breaks on contact.

title: A Treatise on Binding Currents
summary: A treatise on winding water qi round a limb as a cord or a current that holds the opponent and drags the stance.

title: The Undertow Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of pulling moves that turn a forward rush back on itself with the hidden drag of an undertow.

title: Handbook of Cleansing Waters
summary: A handbook of washing the body free of poison and taint with flows of water qi and of guarding the washer meanwhile.

title: The Whirl and Weave Workbook
summary: A workbook on turning water qi in tight rings around the body so each guard also draws the attacker round.

title: Primer of the Pressing Tide
summary: A primer on advancing behind a heavy steady push of water qi that crowds the opponent and does not let go.

title: A Canon of Water Sense and Tracing
summary: A canon on reading the water in air and ground and body to trace where a person has been and how far off they stand.

title: Treatise of the Deep Draught
summary: A treatise on drinking deep from a store of water qi and passing the draught to a weary or wounded ally.
